_comment: Route choice (between levels): the team votes on the next level's route. Each risky route = one risk (below, or a map modifier from unlocks.json once it's unlocked) + one reward. The Safe route is always offered: no risk, no reward. Risk fields work like map modifiers (monsters, elites, haul goal, valueDamage, stamina...). Reward kinds: gear (each player finds a gear item of at least this rarity when the level is cleared: 0 Common, 1 Uncommon, 2 Rare), scrap (haul Scrap x value), luck (+value gear and shop luck on the level), parts (crafting parts each, when the level is cleared).

risks.name: Rough Handling
risks.risk: valuables lose 25% more value when hit

rewards.name: Gear Cache
rewards.desc: everyone finds an Uncommon-or-better gear item when the level is cleared

rewards.name: Rare Cache
rewards.desc: everyone finds a Rare-or-better gear item when the level is cleared

rewards.name: Lucky Find
rewards.desc: +3 gear and shop luck on the level

rewards.name: Salvage Rights
rewards.desc: 4 crafting parts each when the level is cleared
